  "focus_actionability": 0.9,
  "rationale": "The columns collectively and unambiguously centre on ONE coherent, data-inferable focus: the aspects of the dining experience mentioned in reviews. This directly realises the analytical query. The structure is a well-differentiated set of binary aspect indicators (food quality, service, ambiance, value, location, cleanliness, wait time, menu variety) covering distinct, non-redundant facets at a useful granularity, plus a summarizing primary_aspect column that names the dominant theme(s) per review. This is neither a single restatement nor undifferentiated noise, and the aspects are non-trivially distinct from bare sentiment (label_pos already exists). The implied focus is highly actionable: an analyst can quantify which aspects dominate reviews, cross them with polarity, and prioritize operational improvements. Minor deductions: primary_aspect is noisy/free-text with overlapping and off-topic values ('This is not a restaurant review', 'DMV service and location experience'), and some aspects (cleanliness, location) are rarely flagged, slightly weakening granularity balance."
}
